records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Historically its second and third quarter financial results have reflected higher travel demand, and were better than its first and fourth quarter financial results.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: In the three and nine months ended September 30, 2022, the Company recognized approximately $5.1 billion and $3.0 billion, respectively, of passenger revenue for tickets that were included in Advance ticket sales at the beginning of those periods.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: In the three and nine months ended September 30, 2021, the Company recognized approximately $2.8 billion and $1.6 billion, respectively, of passenger revenue for tickets that were included in Advance ticket sales at the beginning of those periods.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: At the beginning of the COVID-19 pandemic, we suspended portions of our international operations, but we resumed service to several international destinations as travel restrictions were eased and demand for travel increased.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Relative to the third quarter of 2019, the Company operated approximately 90% of its capacity for the third quarter of 2022 compared to approximately 72% of its capacity in the third quarter of 2021.
